name: review-assurance-diagnostics-ux
title: Improve review assurance diagnostics and stale-closure runbook
description: Fix the CLI diagnostic UX discovered during B-997b closure. Current problems: autopilot_review_status defaults to default-run and hides custom 3x2 rounds; review_escalation_status does not show voluntarily submitted local 3x2 rounds when escalation is not required; DONE pre-check stale material guidance lists stale host verdicts but does not provide a concise operator runbook for refreshing validation evidence and re-submitting host verdicts. Scope is local non-authoritative diagnostics and runbook clarity only. Non-goals: no future roadmap implementation, no server-backed verification workflow, no external host execution, no unattended orchestration, and no lifecycle gate semantic changes.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: production appears only in excluded scope/non-goal language. This story improves local non-Authority CLI diagnostics and explicitly does not implement production completion or production receipt behavior.
